name: pml
pond_rows: first row nearest the centre unit; later rows toward the player; tiles ordered from the player's left
notes: 1080p coordinates. pond rects are in the de-rotated overhead square (side px, origin at its top-left); rot = clockwise quarter turns that make the owner's tiles upright with the owner at the bottom; the dora indicators lie inside the pond rect on the wall side. hand.roll = angle in degrees of the hand row in the image (positive = descending to the right), measured from the human quads; rotating a crop by -roll makes the tile upright.

pond rects reach the edge of the overhead image (20 overhead px beyond the wall row's usual near edge): the dead wall (dora indicators) lies in the wall row in front of the player, which the overhead view itself may cut
